descricao_original: This image shows the ora serrata at higher magnification. Note how the multilayered, sensory retina (to the right) collapses into a single layer of cuboidal/columnar epithelium over the ciliary body. The pigment epithelium of the retina continues forward and underlies the layer derived from the sensory retina.
creditos_identificados: Image source: Image taken of a slide from the University of Mississippi collection.
